producer_report.summary:
I added `undecided_surface_changes` to `crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs`. It takes a `SurfaceDiff` and the changed paths and returns one finding per surface kind that has changes. It returns none if `docs/decisions.md` is among the paths, ignoring a leading `./`, or if the diff is empty. OLY-A-12 in `docs/spec.toml` now names it as the mechanism, with owner Athena and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`. I added an Unreleased/Added bullet to `CHANGELOG.md` and appended D172 to `docs/decisions.md`. The check is not wired into landing or `athena status`.

The new test builds old and new inventories by hand and runs the real `diff`. The test passes. It failed when I stubbed the function to return no findings, and I restored it afterwards.

fmt, clippy and `cargo test --locked` all passed, as did the named tests that read the spec, the decision log and the changelog.

The check tests the path only: text appended to the log without a new `## D<n>` heading still silences it. D172 records that limit.")

checks_run.note: fails at the first assertion (left [], right the three findings); stub reverted
Exit 0; output was too large to read inline, so the failure grep was not possible

criteria_check.criterion: docs/spec.toml OLY-A-12 has mechanism naming the new function in crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs (Grep finds that function there), owner "Athena", and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names the test (cargo test -p athena-core design_surface).
criteria_check.evidence: OLY-A-12 in docs/spec.toml now has a mechanism naming `undecided_surface_changes` in crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs, owner = "Athena", and a measure ending `status: not shown` that names `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`. `pub fn undecided_surface_changes` is in design_surface.rs. `cargo test -p xtask --test spec` (30 passed) and `cargo test -p athena-core --lib the_real_spec_records_every_field` both pass on the new text.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface`: a new test passes showing that when diff(old,new) is non-empty and the changed paths exclude docs/decisions.md the new check reports the undecided surface changes, and when docs/decisions.md is among the paths, or the diff is empty, it reports none. The test fails if the function body is replaced by returning no findings.
criteria_check.evidence: `cargo test -p athena-core design_surface` gave 8 passed, including a_surface_change_without_a_decision_is_reported_and_one_with_it_is_not. It asserts three findings (commands, roles, crates) without the log, none with docs/decisions.md or ./docs/decisions.md, and none for an empty diff. With the body stubbed to return no findings, the test failed (left [], right the three findings). I then restored the body.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets` and `cargo test --workspace`; all pass, including the xtask spec test that requires the measure marker.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`; all exited 0. The named tests also passed: xtask spec and policy, the hestia real-spec test, and the athena-cli backtest, mirrors, ontology and design_surface tests.

criteria_check.criterion: Only docs/spec.toml, crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs and CHANGELOG.md change; no governance file (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows) and no record schema is added, so the check_record_file/AnyRecord round trip is unaffected. The check is not wired into landing or refusal, so no reading is newly refused (expected 0% of newly refused readings).
criteria_check.evidence: `git status --short` lists CHANGELOG.md, crates/athena-core/src/design_surface.rs, docs/decisions.md and docs/spec.toml. docs/decisions.md is an expected deliverable and the plan lists it, though this criterion's sentence does not name it. No governance file, record schema or run/checks.rs was touched. Nothing calls the new function outside its test, so no reading is newly refused.

open_issues: The check is not wired into landing, admission or `athena status`, so OLY-A-12 is not enforced in practice; the measure stays `status: not shown`, as planned.
The check tests the path only. Text appended to docs/decisions.md with no new `## D<n>` heading still silences it (stated in the doc comment and D172).
DECISION_LOG now exists twice (design_surface.rs and run/checks.rs:7). Merging them is left to the wiring job (recorded in D172).
learnings: The Bash hook allows only cargo, chmod, git, ls, mv and rm; a pipe to tail is refused.
Edits to the appended end of docs/decisions.md work by anchoring on the last lines of the previous entry.
